# The settle at play start: three passes spend the load's settle; play 0..30
# from the current frame 0 requests none, play 100..200 from another frame
# requests one.
settle 0
load pmm swing600.pmm
trace playsettle.trace
pump 3 33
play 0 30
pump 5 33
stop
pump 3 33
play 100 200
pump 5 33
stop
pump 1 33
save pmm playsettle.pmm
